title: Deck and king beds 1 mile to downtown free parking
description:
1 mile to downtown. Walk, bike or scooter to 12 South, the Gulch, Vanderbilt, Belmont, and Hillsboro Village. Sunny deck, comfy seating amenities, and convenient location.

The space
Corner unit of a brick triplex with a deck and a gated courtyard.
Fully equipped with microwave, toaster, coffee maker, small dining table, and washer dryer.
Private has chairs and a table, a nice hangout for your morning coffee or evening cocktail.

Guest access
The courtyard is available for frisbee and sunbathing.
For those with mobility issues, the front entrance has a handrail and 10 steps, or you can enter from the alley where there is free parking and the gate entrance is level. The front door entrance has 3 stairs up the deck.

Other things to note
